paragraphs: Wake Intelligence: 5-Layer Temporal Intelligence for AI Agents A production-ready Model Context Protocol (MCP) server implementing a temporal intelligence "brain" with five layers: Past (causality tracking), Present (memory management), Future (predictive pre-fetching), Adaptive (meta-learning — per-project weight tuning), and Personality (temporal postures that shape how context is retrieved and presented). Reference implementation of Semantic Intent as Single Source of Truth patterns with hexagonal architecture.
features: ✅ Flexibility: Swap infrastructure (D1 → Postgres) without touching domain
✅ Semantic Intent: Comprehensive documentation of WHY
✅ Type Safety: Strong TypeScript contracts throughout
